description: Source code for jffs2 on-disk structure generator and manipulator for MTD flash memory, including functions for creating, parsing, and writing JFFS2 filesystem structures.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the erase block size, erasing and writing blocks as needed.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry with specified name, type, and parent inode.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode and associated directory entry.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to the filesystem structure, reading file contents and creating corresponding inodes.
